skill.summary: AI-powered job search assistant that searches multiple job boards, matches opportunities against your CV, and helps you apply faster.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of job-search-agent.

- Search multiple job boards (LinkedIn Jobs, Indeed, Glassdoor, and more) from one interface
- Match job opportunities against your CV and rank by fit
- Auto-apply to multiple matching jobs with one command
- Track applications in one place
- Generate personalized cover letters for each application
